title: Mapping transcription factor functions in astrocytes using in vivo gain-of-function Perturb-seq | Science
content: An in vivo approach combining high-throughput screening with cell type–specific readouts could enable elucidation of genotype-phenotype relationships in complex tissues. We developed an in vivo gain-of-function Perturb-seq platform, termed iGOF–Perturb-...
